name: file-read
description: Portable MCP read_file tool for reading local text files with offset and limit arguments.

args: root="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if [ -z "${root}" ] && [ -f ./mcp-server-read/server.sh ]; then root=.; fi; if [ -z "${root}" ] && [ -f ./plugins/file-read/mcp-server-read/server.sh ]; then root=./plugins/file-read; fi; if [ -z "${root}" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'file-read: unable to locate plugin root' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec bash "${root}/mcp-server-read/server.sh"

interface.shortDescription: Read local text files through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Adds a portable read_file MCP tool with file_path, offset, and limit arguments and line-numbered text output.
defaultPrompt: Read README.md with the read_file tool.
Read the first 200 lines of a source file.
